## Purpose

This document defines a reusable preparation note for the HW01 oral defense.

Goals:

* Prepare concise explanations for random defense questions
* Connect answers to real evidence and artifacts
* Show human understanding beyond AI output
* Practice explaining test-design decisions
* Prepare to discuss AI mistakes and corrections

---

## File Naming Format

```text
ORAL_DEFENSE_<topic_or_id>.md
```

Example:

```text
ORAL_DEFENSE_TC-005_rapid_power_reconnect.md
```

---

## 1. Topic

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Related requirement | R1 / R2 / R3 / AI compliance |
| Related artifact | JOB-XXX / DEF-XXX / TC-XXX / AI-OBS-XXX |
| Evidence | EV-XXX / URL / path |
| Status | DRAFT / REVIEWED / VERIFIED |

---

## 2. One-Minute Explanation

```text
Explain the artifact or decision in plain language.
```

---

## 3. Why I Chose This

```text
Explain why this job, defect, test input, edge case, or correction was selected.
```

---

## 4. Evidence I Can Point To

| Evidence | What it proves |
| --- | --- |
| EV-XXX |  |

---

## 5. Possible Questions

| Question | Short Answer |
| --- | --- |
| Why did you choose this input? |  |
| What would happen with a different input? |  |
| What did AI get wrong here? |  |
| How did you verify this? |  |
| What would you improve if you had more time? |  |

---

## 6. Live Demonstration Notes

```text
Steps to reproduce or explain the artifact live.
```

---

## Final Notes

An oral defense answer should be short, concrete, and evidence-backed. Do not memorize AI text; understand the decision and be ready to explain it in your own words.
